items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: I mean Monk used to call him Slam Pettiford.

ctx.x: I kind of enjoy the fact that it’s intangible, because that’s what makes the greats. If it wasn’t intangible, then we’d all be on the same level I guess.
Well and I think some of that intangibility is the voice. It’s really being true. I mean we take in everything. I mean Ray is certainly — I mean Monk used to call him Slam Pettiford.
